reviews.text:
Grandma Jazz is THE place to go! 💯

It was my first time smoking up after 6 years, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The vibe was amazing, and everyone at Grandma Jazz was so friendly and welcoming that I felt comfortable right away.

They’ve got a great seating area where you can relax, smoke, and enjoy a fantastic view. And most importantly, the quality of the buds are genuine and top-notch ( I had such a great high, I over estimated my self to handle it 😂).

Highly recommend this place! 💯

Oh, and don’t leave without trying the cola! 🥤🔥

Ps. The attention to detail is also something I loved. Where they serve you water because well your gonna be parched and also the take away bags they pack the stuff are a cool storage sack! Which becomes your little weed bag with all the stuff. Well done GJ
One of the best places in Phuket that you must visit ❤️

What a privilege it was to enjoy a smoke at this beautiful place. The owners are incredibly nice and the space is decorated beautifully. Do not miss this place if you enjoy a real sesh experience. PS. Get the craft cherry cola from Chang Mai it’s unreal.
Great cannabis shop! The store is clean, the atmosphere is nice, and the staff are very friendly and helpful. Good selection, reasonable prices, and excellent service. Highly recommended!
Amazing strains, staff and view 420/420 would recommend.
Grandma Jazz terbaik, sampai jumpa dalam lain kesempatan 🔥
reviews.text_en: Best Grandma Jazz, see you next time 🔥

reviews.text:
So Phuket is unfortunately famous (or infamous) just for its beaches, the girls, and the party scene. If I may be so humble as to suggest that Grandma Jazz ought to be something you think about the next time you are in Phuket.

I love Grandma Jazz for providing a canvass upon which friends may converse and revel simply in the state of being, without artifice or pretence.

The owners, AC and Joy have really put a lot of thought into the decor and ambience of the place (reminds me a lot of Tantric Jazz in Bristol, funnily enough), from the lighting, to the floor tiles, the wallpaper, the packaging of their jeweled products.

There is a time and place for everything. You owe it to yourself to find the time for conversation. The place, you should already know!

I absolutely loved this little gem. I actually came here about a year ago, and I remembered how cozy and welcoming it was, so I decided to come back—and I’m so glad I did.

The interior is beautiful and thoughtfully designed, with such a warm atmosphere that makes you want to stay for hours. The tiny lemon cakes were such a cute touch (and honestly, so good 😋).

I also joined their quiz night, and it brought me right back to my days in Korea when my friends and I used to do trivia nights just for fun. It was such a nostalgic and genuinely fun experience.

The owner and the staff are incredibly kind and welcoming, and you can tell they truly love what they do. Places with this kind of passion are rare, and it really shows. I’ll definitely be back again. ❤️

An amazing serene place with Great Music and AC is an absolute gentleman. We love coming here straight from the airport so we can transform into chill vibes ASAP. Wishing more love n luck to AC & Joy and hope to keep visiting the Fam!!

AC’s shop is one of the biggest reason why I want to return to Phuket, because of your genuine generosity and hospitality. Every little details matters in life and this is deeply reflected within every corner of your shop. Thank you for having me and I can’t wait to be back 🙏💪🤛❤️

Кайфовый кофешоп и очень классные ребята - Айси и Джои !
Сразу понимаешь, что они реально вкладывают душу в своё место, за что большой респект 🫡
Атмосфера тёплая и расслабленная, внутри чисто и уютно, а музыка подобрана просто идеально, создаёт именно тот вайб, который хочется.
Качество и атмосфера на таком уровне, что хочется возвращаться снова и снова.
Обязательно буду рекомендовать всем своим!

Спасибо вам, Айси и Джои, за настоящий тёплый приём и отличное настроение!✨
reviews.text_en:
Awesome coffee shop and incredibly cool guys – Icy and Joey!
You can tell right away that they really put their heart and soul into their place, for which I have great respect 🫡
The atmosphere is warm and relaxed, it's clean and cozy inside, and the music is perfectly chosen, creating exactly the vibe you're looking for.
The quality and atmosphere are so high that you'll want to come back again and again.
I'll definitely recommend them to everyone!

Thank you, Icy and Joey, for the truly warm welcome and great atmosphere!✨

reviews.text: I’m really glad I found this place. The atmosphere is relaxed, the view is beautiful, and it’s one of those places where you can just slow down and enjoy your time. A special thanks to Icy and Joey for being genuinely kind and welcoming. You can tell they care about the people who come here, and that makes a real difference. Wishing you guys all the best — I’ll definitely be back. Highly recommended!🔝

Grandma Jazz is an absolute gem in Phuket. Every visit is a fantastic experience with genuinely outstanding service from a team that makes you feel like family from the moment you arrive. The atmosphere is relaxed, the views are incredible, and it’s the perfect place to unwind with great food, drinks, and even better company. Whether it’s your first visit or your tenth, it’s always a memorable time. If you’re looking for amazing hospitality, beautiful scenery, and a place you’ll want to return to again and again, Grandma Jazz is a must-visit. Highly recommended!
10/10 amazing venue, amazing people and amazing service - oh and the buds amazing too

Grandma Jazz is IT. Everything I wanted out of a cannabis lounge—beautiful space and view, incredibly friendly and knowledgeable staff, an intentional curation of high-quality strains, and that chill vibe. Do yourself a favor and pop up the hill for a visit. You won't regret it.
Вернулась сюда спустя 3 года, и здесь все так же круто! Поверьте, это лучший шоп, который вы можете посетить в жизни!
reviews.text_en: I came back here after three years, and everything is just as amazing! Trust me, this is the best shop you'll ever visit!

reviews.text: Felt like a big ol’ slab of butter…melting on top of a pile of flapjacks. Everything I hoped it would be and more.
No other place like it. The vibes are unmatched and the staff is welcoming and friendly.

Kamala附近最佳的大麻咖啡店，店主是英國人，我告知自己來自台灣，他說和知名演員鳳小岳是同學。

店內環境和音樂品味極佳，適合起床來抽一根，發呆一下午
reviews.text_en:
The best cannabis cafe near Kamala. The owner is British; when I told him I was from Taiwan, he said he was a classmate of the famous actor Rhydian Vaughan.

The ambiance and music are excellent, perfect for waking up early, having a smoke, and daydreaming for an afternoon.

reviews.text:
Ein sehr schön eingerichtetes Café, in dem man sich sofort wohlfühlt, mit hellen, freundlichen Farben, geschmackvollen Details und gemütlichen Sitzecken.

Das Personal ist durchgehend höflich und nett, immer mit einem Lächeln, zuvorkommend, beratend bei der Auswahl der Getränke und aufmerksam für individuelle Wünsche.

Das Filterkaffee-Erlebnis war das beste der letzten zwei Wochen – klarer, aromatischer Geschmack mit milder Note, perfekte Brühtemperatur und Tiefe im Aroma, sowie eine saubere, frische Zubereitung. Der Cold Cappuccino war ebenfalls fantastisch: angenehme Kälte, cremiger Schaum, ausgewogenes Verhältnis von Kaffee und Milchschaum und frischer Geschmack ohne Nachgeschmack. Insgesamt sehr empfehlenswert – ideal für einen entspannten Vormittag oder Nachmittag, besonders für Kaffee-Liebhaber und Genießer; jederzeit würde ich wiederkommen.
reviews.text_en:
A beautifully decorated café where you immediately feel at ease, with bright, cheerful colors, tasteful details, and cozy seating areas.

The staff is consistently polite and friendly, always smiling, attentive, helpful with drink selections, and responsive to individual requests.

The filter coffee was the best I've had in the last two weeks – a clear, aromatic flavor with a mild note, perfect brewing temperature and depth of aroma, and clean, fresh preparation. The cold cappuccino was also fantastic: pleasantly cold, creamy foam, a balanced ratio of coffee to milk foam, and a fresh taste with no aftertaste. Highly recommended overall – ideal for a relaxing morning or afternoon, especially for coffee lovers and connoisseurs; I would definitely return.

reviews.text: Basicamente o melhor coffeeshop de Phuket, fui com a minha mulher, fomos muito bem atendidos, com o dono fazendo algumas dinâmicas para os clientes interagirem. Toda atenção a cada detalhe
reviews.text_en: Basically the best coffee shop in Phuket. I went with my wife, and we received excellent service, with the owner organizing activities to encourage customer interaction. They paid close attention to every detail.

reviews.text: Grandma Jazz truly feels like a safe place for the heart. I’ve rarely felt this comfortable somewhere so quickly. The name fits perfectly because being there feels as warm and welcoming as being at your grandma’s home. AC and Joy are such genuine, wonderful people, and their energy really makes the experience special. The entire vibe is calming, cozy, and honestly mesmerizing. I’ll definitely be coming back. P.S. try the craft cherry cola. It‘s one of the best cheryy cola‘s I‘ve had in my life

If you’re in Kamala and want a place that actually feels soulful instead of commercialized, make time for Grandma Jazz - Weed & Cannabis Cafe. AC and Joy are truly the heart of the experience — they make you feel less like a customer and more like you’ve been welcomed into their living room.

The coffee is excellent, the cannabis selection is curated with care, and the atmosphere is something special. The large outdoor patios overlook the Kamala valley with an almost unreal level of peace and beauty. Sitting there with the breeze, music, and jungle views genuinely feels therapeutic.

What makes this place stand out is the serenity. No chaotic party vibe, no tourist-trap energy — just calm, warmth, good conversation, and thoughtful hospitality. One of the rare places that actually lives up to being called a hidden gem in Phuket.

I’ll absolutely be back.
Красиво

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Absolutely next level – I’d give 10 stars if I could.

AC & JOY runs a truly luxurious, old-school soft weed club with a vibe that’s impossible to beat. The strains they offer are hands down the best I’ve seen in a very long time – top quality, carefully curated, and just pure perfection.

But it’s not just about the product. The service is warm, welcoming, and genuinely top-tier. I’ve been to plenty of cafés, restaurants, and clubs, but nowhere – and I mean nowhere – have I experienced this level of excellence. AC & JOY outshines them all.

If you’re looking for a premium, classic soft weed experience with impeccable service and the finest strains around, this is the place. Honestly, 5 stars doesn’t feel like enough. Massive respect and thanks to the whole team! 🙌

Grandma Jazz in Kamala is easily one of the best cannabis lounge/shop experiences I’ve had in Thailand. The quality, terp profiles, freshness, and overall selection are top tier — you can tell they actually care about the flower instead of just pushing tourist packs. Staff were welcoming, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about cannabis culture. Super clean setup, chill vibe, fair prices, and the whole experience felt premium from start to finish. As a cannabis connoisseur and Google Local Guide, this is a real 5-star spot. Absolute gem in Kamala
